title: On Fixed Points of Nonlinear Monotone and Strongly Concave Operators Acting in Normal Cones
summary: We introduce and study a new class of nonlinear monotone operators acting in normal cones of real Banach spaces and possessing the property of strong concavity. We establish new constructive principles for the existence of nonzero fixed points for this class of operators. Further, we prove that the corresponding iterative process converges to the fixed point at geometric rate. We also establish the uniqueness of the fixed point in a sufficiently wide conical segment.
